userValue: Keep normal Wanxiang/Rime pinyin, fuzzy pinyin, paging, dictionary ranking, fallback, and composition-time numeric selection stable while RAG-IME is present.
currentStatus: Patched route and tests exist; a public-safe deployed-librime suite passes 10/10 Top-1 cases, while real Squirrel foreground proof is still required.
failureFallback: Rime candidates stay visible; sidecar/model/RAG failure must not clear composition candidates.
userVisibleBehavior: User can type pinyin, page, and use ordinary number keys for Rime candidates.

userValue: Learn from an actual native Rime choice without letting model, RAG, memory, Notion, or DeepSeek output pollute the Rime dictionary lane.
currentStatus: The source-restricted endpoint, successful-selection hook, sensitive-field guard, review-only export, and tests exist; no fresh foreground native selection has produced acceptance evidence yet.
realImeTrigger: librime successfully commits a native Rime candidate selected from the current composition page
keyPolicy: ordinary Rime composition selection remains authoritative; recording runs only after a successful native selection and never changes the live page
dataSource: raw pinyin/preedit, accepted native Rime text, rank, optional rejected top candidate, and a deduplicated selection id; Rime userdb remains authoritative

userVisibleBehavior: Normal Rime selection stays unchanged; repeated reviewed corrections may improve a later explicitly deployed user dictionary.

userValue: Use current-document memory without leaking short-term text from another document or calling a model after every commit.
currentStatus: Context Group, commit-burst, T0 phrase, local suffix, compiler, and replay gates exist; real foreground Group-switch proof is still required.
realImeTrigger: trusted post-commit foreground snapshot after a 500ms commit burst
candidateSourceType: model / memory; Memory Book title and raw history are evidence-only

dataSource: deterministic Context Group short buffer plus validated Memory Book phrase/surface hints and TagMemo retrieval
failureFallback: Unreliable or stale context, duplicate hashes, rate limits, delete cooldown, cross-Group short-term evidence, and remote providers fail closed.
userVisibleBehavior: A continuous sentence normally creates one short local prediction opportunity; changing document does not surface the previous document's short-term text.

userValue: After committed text, show 1-3 short source-marked local completions, then let Tab or Option+number accept one and continue prediction without doing pinyin-constrained generation.
currentStatus: Async post-commit, source-aware overlay, selection receipt, and progressive follow-up contracts exist. Backend acceptance returns three model rows plus one local RAG row and a separate DeepSeek action; the native four-row card no longer truncates RAG, but real foreground overlay/selection proof is still required.
candidateSourceType: model; the same source-aware overlay may render separately governed rag/memory rows
dataSource: local MLX predictor, source badge contract, and accepted foreground candidate id/source/rank/context anchors
failureFallback: Capture failure is fail-closed; pending/timeout/empty model results must not clear a legal existing overlay, and stale or mismatched selections must not commit.
userVisibleBehavior: User sees source-marked short continuations after committing text, accepts one with Tab or Option+number, and can receive a later follow-up opportunity.
tests: python3 -m unittest tests.test_rime_sidecar tests.test_prediction_quality tests.test_source_contracts tests.test_squirrel_frontend_trace -v

userValue: Show useful personal/project memory candidates without repeating raw old input or current context.
currentStatus: Curated-memory policy exists; realtime foreground display still needs trace proof.
keyPolicy: post_commit side candidates: Tab / Option+number; ordinary digits pass through
dataSource: curated/accepted/durable/project/high-confidence local SQLite memory; raw append-only history is not displayed directly
failureFallback: Uncurated, tombstoned, rejected, echo, low-signal, or prompt-leak memory candidates are filtered fail-closed.

userValue: Provide one supported React Control Center for runtime status, settings, Agent sessions, Rooms, memory review, knowledge work, and scoped repair actions across the native Mac host and authenticated tailnet devices.

realImeTrigger: the user explicitly opens RagImeControl.app, uses the patched Squirrel menu, or opens the Agent Gateway from an authenticated tailnet device; none of these actions run on the keystroke path

userValue: Dictate at the current cursor with live revisions while keeping microphone/network work outside Squirrel and outside typing history.

candidateSourceType: volatile voice transcript, not a Rime/model/RAG/memory candidate
